module_summary: Ring buffer with register-array storage: valid/ready writes advance a wrap-bit write pointer, random-access reads are range-checked between pointers, and the read pointer advances by a variable step.

anchors.name: mem_q
anchors.why: Depth-entry register array holding buffered data.

anchors.name: wptr_q
anchors.why: Write pointer with wrap bit; addresses writes, increments per write.

anchors.name: rptr_q
anchors.why: Read pointer with wrap bit; advanced by step_i.

anchors.name: wvalid_i
anchors.why: Write request valid; with ready stores wdata and bumps wptr.

anchors.name: wready_o
anchors.why: Write ready when buffer not full.

anchors.name: wdata_i
anchors.why: Write data stored at write pointer.

anchors.name: raddr_i
anchors.why: Random-access read address, range-checked against pointers.

anchors.name: rdata_o
anchors.why: Read data from mem_q at raddr.

anchors.name: rready_o
anchors.why: Read ready only when raddr lies between read and write pointers.

anchors.name: advance_i
anchors.why: Command to advance read pointer by step.

anchors.name: full_o
anchors.why: Full when pointers equal except wrap bit; blocks writes.

anchors.name: empty_o
anchors.why: Empty when write and read pointers equal.

groups.name: Ring storage
groups.description: Register array written at wptr, read randomly at raddr.

groups.name: Pointer and status logic
groups.description: Write/read pointers, full/empty, and read range check.
